full_prompt_en: A square fantasy illustration presents a small doll-like face centered within a dense field of antique gold relief. The background is almost entirely filled with embossed scrolls, tiny circles, fan-shaped ribs, and worn recesses, so there is little empty space around the central form. A wide circular ornament surrounds the head, its radiating narrow panels visible on both sides. Across the upper center, overlapping scales form a rounded cap beneath a thin curling rim; a small ring sits exactly at the top. The face below is smooth, pale ivory-gold, and nearly symmetrical. Oversized dark eyes look straight outward from broad rounded sockets, while a slight nose and tiny pursed lips give the expression a still, enigmatic quality. Thin shadows under the brow and around the eyes make the flat front view feel gently modeled. At the lower center, a narrow neck leads into a patterned collar and a short visible section of layered decorative clothing. Large matching spiral medallions sit to the left and right of the neck, balancing the circular headpiece. Every surrounding surface carries fine incisions, small raised dots, and darker bronze grooves, suggesting carved or cast material rather than loose brushwork. The palette stays close to honey, sand, old brass, and muted brown, with the pale face standing out through value rather than a separate bright hue. Soft frontal light catches the projecting relief and leaves narrow shadows in the carved channels. The overall composition is frontal, compact, and ceremonial, using repeated radial and spiral forms to make the smooth central face appear both delicate and uncanny.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形幻想插画在密集的古金色浮雕中间呈现一张小巧的娃娃般面孔。背景几乎被凸起卷草纹、小圆点、扇形肋纹和磨旧凹处填满，使中央形体周围没有多少空白。一道宽圆形装饰围住头部，两侧都可见放射状窄片。上方中央，层层重叠的鳞片在细卷边下形成圆帽，顶端正中还有一个小圆环。其下的脸平滑、浅象牙金色，几乎左右对称。特大的深色眼睛从宽圆眼眶中直视画外，轻微的鼻子和微微噘起的小嘴带来静止、神秘的表情。眉下及眼周的细阴影使平视的脸有柔和体积。下方中央，一截细颈连接花纹领圈和一小段层叠装饰衣饰。颈部左右各有一个相称的大螺旋纹章，平衡圆形头饰。周围每一处表面都带细刻线、微凸点及较深的青铜色凹槽，像雕刻或铸造材料，而非松散笔触。色彩集中在蜂蜜、沙色、旧黄铜和柔褐范围内，浅色面孔靠明度而不是另一种鲜艳色相突出。柔和正面光接住凸起浮雕，在刻槽中留下狭窄阴影。整体构图正面、紧凑而带仪式感，重复的放射与螺旋形体使平滑的中央面孔既精巧又隐约古怪。
style_prompt_en: The image has the finish of a finely modeled fantasy relief, with matte gold and old brass surfaces packed into a near-symmetrical arrangement. Broad smooth planes are set against extremely dense incised ornament, so quiet areas gain focus through the surrounding detail. Narrow raised borders, repeating scales, dots, and curling grooves create a tactile rhythm rather than a flat printed pattern. Honey and ivory highlights sit over sand and bronze shadows, keeping the palette close in hue while varying depth. Soft frontal illumination catches raised edges and leaves thin dark channels between them. Rounded outlines and radial repetitions organize the crowded square without much open background. The overall effect is antique, intricate, and subtly uncanny, with material texture carrying much of the visual interest.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有精细塑造的幻想浮雕质感，哑光金与旧黄铜表面聚成近乎对称的布局。宽阔平滑的色面与极密的刻纹并置，安静区域因此借周围细节成为焦点。细窄凸边、重复鳞片、圆点与卷曲凹槽形成可触的节奏，而不是平面的印刷纹样。蜂蜜色和象牙色亮部覆盖沙色与青铜阴影，使配色在相近色相内通过深浅变化建立层次。柔和正面光落在凸起边缘，在它们之间留下细暗槽。圆润轮廓与放射式重复组织拥挤的方形画面，背景几乎没有空白。整体效果古旧、繁密且微带怪诞感，材料肌理承载了大量视觉趣味。
theme_en: A symmetrical fantasy doll face set within ornate carved golden relief
theme_zh: 嵌在繁密金色雕饰中的对称幻想娃娃面孔
name: Naoto Hattori
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
